source_meta._title: Dash in villager/trader UI is hardcoded / untranslatable

stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition 1.15.2 client in a vanilla single-player environment, using English (US), a minimal custom resource pack, and a Creative superflat world with commands enabled. Filesystem access is required to create the resource pack. Do not use the listed fix version, 1.20.2 Pre-release 1.
preconditions: Configure the Minecraft Launcher to start the exact Java Edition version 1.15.2, which is the first version listed as affected.
Use a clean vanilla profile without mods, translation-modifying clients, or other resource packs that override English language entries.

Ensure the executor can create folders and plain-text files in the resource-pack directory. File extensions must remain visible so that pack.mcmeta and en_us.json are not accidentally saved with a .txt suffix.
Use the action bound to Use Item/Place Block when instructed to right-click. With default controls, this is the right mouse button.
The report provides no world seed, coordinates, server requirement, or original test resource pack, so the plan uses a deterministic summoned novice cartographer and a minimal language-override pack.

steps.action: Start Minecraft Java Edition using the 1.15.2 installation and wait for the main menu to finish loading.
steps.success_cue: The main menu is responsive and the displayed version is 1.15.2.

steps.action: From the main menu, open the resource-pack directory through the game UI: click Options, click Resource Packs, and then click Open Resource Pack Folder.
steps.exact_input: Options -> Resource Packs -> Open Resource Pack Folder
steps.success_cue: The operating system's file browser is open at the resourcepacks directory used by this 1.15.2 installation.

steps.action: Inside the resourcepacks directory, create a folder named MC-177172-test. Inside it, create the nested directory path assets/minecraft/lang. Keep all directory names lowercase except for the chosen top-level pack name.
steps.success_cue: The directory MC-177172-test contains the nested assets/minecraft/lang directory.

steps.action: Create a plain-text file named pack.mcmeta directly inside MC-177172-test and save the supplied JSON exactly. Resource-pack format 5 is appropriate for Java Edition 1.15.2. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Template%3AResource_pack_format?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: MC-177172-test/pack.mcmeta exists, has no additional .txt extension, and contains valid JSON with pack_format set to 5.

steps.action: Create a plain-text file named en_us.json inside MC-177172-test/assets/minecraft/lang and save the supplied JSON exactly. This deliberately replaces the two translated strings adjacent to the separator with conspicuous labels; it does not supply or assume a translation key for the separator itself.
steps.success_cue: MC-177172-test/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json exists, has no additional .txt extension, and contains the two specified translation entries.

steps.action: Return to Minecraft. If MC-177172-test is not visible immediately, click Done to leave the Resource Packs screen and then reopen Options -> Resource Packs to refresh the list.
steps.success_cue: A resource pack with the description MC-177172 reproduction is visible under Available Resource Packs or Selected Resource Packs.

steps.action: Enable MC-177172-test by clicking its selection arrow so that it moves to Selected Resource Packs. Click Done and do not continue until the resource reload has completed.
steps.success_cue: The resource-pack screen closes, the menu becomes responsive after reloading, and MC-177172-test remains in Selected Resource Packs when the screen is reopened.

steps.action: Set the client language to English (US), matching the resource pack's en_us.json file: from Options, open Language, select English (US), and click Done.
steps.success_cue: The menus are displayed in English and English (US) is the selected language.

steps.action: Return to the main menu, click Singleplayer, and click Create New World.
steps.success_cue: The Create New World configuration screen is open.

steps.action: Enter a recognizable world name and cycle the Game Mode button until it displays Creative.
steps.exact_input: World Name: MC-177172 reproduction; Game Mode: Creative
steps.success_cue: The world name is set and the creation screen displays Game Mode: Creative.

steps.action: Open More World Options. Set Allow Cheats to ON and cycle World Type until it displays Superflat. Leave the seed empty because the report specifies no seed.
steps.exact_input: More World Options -> Allow Cheats: ON; World Type: Superflat
steps.success_cue: The configuration displays Allow Cheats: ON and World Type: Superflat.

steps.action: Click Create New World and wait until terrain has rendered and normal movement responds without loading pauses.
steps.success_cue: The player is standing in the newly created superflat world, nearby terrain is rendered, and movement is responsive.

steps.action: Press T, or the currently bound Open Chat control, to open in-game chat. The command must be run in the game chat with its leading slash included.
steps.success_cue: The chat input field is open and ready to accept a command.

steps.action: Enter the supplied command exactly and press Enter. It summons a stationary, persistent novice cartographer two blocks toward positive Z with one guaranteed trade. The VillagerData and Offers NBT structures used here are documented for custom villager summons. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial%3AUseful_commands?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The command completes without a syntax error and an adult cartographer villager is visible near the player.

steps.action: Move within interaction range of the summoned villager and aim the crosshair directly at its body. Do not attack it and do not execute another command.
steps.exact_input: Use movement controls, then center the crosshair on the cartographer villager
steps.success_cue: The cartographer is centered under the crosshair and is close enough to use without moving farther.

steps.action: Press the Use Item/Place Block control once; with default controls, right-click the cartographer. Wait only until the trading interface has fully rendered. Using a profession-bearing adult villager opens its trading interface and displays its profession and level. ([zh.minecraft.wiki](https://zh.minecraft.wiki/w/%E4%BA%A4%E6%98%93?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The cartographer trading interface is open and its header area is fully rendered; no further interaction has been performed.

stor.handoff_condition: The MC-177172-test resource pack is active, English (US) is selected, and the novice cartographer's trading interface has just finished opening. Hand control to the observation subsystem before closing the interface or changing resources.
uncertainties: The Mojira report does not contain a formal Steps to Reproduce section. The custom resource pack, Creative superflat world, and deterministic summon command are the minimum reconstructed execution path supported by the description and code excerpt.
The original screenshot attachment is not required for this procedure and was not used to infer additional setup conditions.

The report discusses the villager/trader UI generally, but its description and code excerpt specifically identify the profession-and-level header rendered for a leveled villager. This plan therefore uses a novice cartographer rather than a wandering trader.

The exact summon command was not supplied by the report. It is an operational replacement for random village exploration and preserves the report-relevant state: a profession-bearing villager at career level 1 with an accessible trading interface.

The replacement strings [PROFESSION] and [LEVEL] are diagnostic text chosen for this reproduction; they are not strings supplied by the report. The translation keys themselves are derived from the report's explanation and code excerpt.
